title: Strang splitting estimator for nonlinear multivariate stochastic differential equations with Pearson-type multiplicative noise
summary: Multivariate Pearson diffusions are characterized by a linear drift and a diffusion matrix that is quadratic in the state variables. We derive closed-form expressions for the mean and covariance matrix of this class using matrix exponential integrals, and extend this framework to a broader class of nonlinear diffusions with Pearson-type multiplicative noise.
